note: The NCI-N87 HER2-amplified gastric model that correctly called trastuzumab (ToGA, 2010) also called lapatinib, T-DM1 and pertuzumab, which all failed in patients; only trastuzumab deruxtecan (2020) repeated a model success.
label: Gastric cancer (HER2)

engagement.model: HER2-amplified gastric cell line NCI-N87 (in vitro and xenograft)
engagement.note: Trastuzumab inhibited NCI-N87 as well as breast SKBR-3; no published comparison with HER2 target engagement in gastric patients.
engagement.short: Gastric line as trastuzumab-sensitive as breast
engagement.quote: HER-2/neu targeting antibody trastuzumab inhibited the growth of a p185(HER-2/neu) overexpressing gastric and breast carcinoma cell lines (N87 and SKBR-3) with equal efficacy.
engagement.judgement: Abstract-level reading (paywalled). 89Zr-trastuzumab PET later measured HER2 uptake in esophagogastric patients (O'Donoghue 2018, doi:10.2967/jnumed.117.194555: no or minimal uptake in 3 of 10 patients) and Sanchez-Vega 2019 (doi:10.1158/2159-8290.CD-18-0598) tied heterogeneous PET uptake to genomic heterogeneity and mixed response, but neither compares a model's engagement prediction with the patient read-out, so the cell stays untested.

dose.model: NCI-N87 and 4-1ST HER2-amplified gastric xenografts (trastuzumab with capecitabine/cisplatin)
dose.note: ToGA carried the breast dose (8/6 mg/kg) into gastric; the xenografts set no exposure target and no model-patient dose comparison was published.
dose.short: Breast dose carried over, model untested
dose.quote: A three-drug combination of capecitabine, cisplatin, and trastuzumab showed remarkable tumor growth inhibition.
dose.reason: Dose carried from breast; no comparison
dose.judgement: Abstract-level reading (paywalled). Tanner 2005 already grew N87 xenografts, so model_first_use_year is 2005; the entry opens in 2007 because that is the Chugai/Roche combination study behind the ToGA regimen. HELOISE (Shah 2017, doi:10.1200/JCO.2016.71.6852; NCT01450696 results posted 2016-11-28) raised maintenance trastuzumab to 10 mg/kg because gastric patients run lower troughs than breast patients; higher exposure gave no OS gain (HR 1.24). That is a patient-only PK finding with no preclinical prediction behind it, so it does not change the status.

efficacy.model: HER2-amplified gastric cell line NCI-N87 (in vitro and xenograft)
efficacy.note: First use: trastuzumab inhibited HER2-amplified NCI-N87 in vitro and as xenografts; proposed as the rationale for gastric trials.
efficacy.short: NCI-N87 model proposed for gastric trials
efficacy.quote: HER-2 might be a useful target in this disease, and this hypothesis deserves to be investigated in clinical trials.

efficacy.model: NCI-N87 and 4-1ST HER2-amplified gastric xenografts (trastuzumab with capecitabine/cisplatin)
efficacy.note: ToGA: trastuzumab plus capecitabine/cisplatin extended survival 13.8 vs 11.1 months, matching the xenograft call for the same three-drug regimen.
efficacy.short: ToGA survival gain matched xenograft call
efficacy.quote: Median overall survival was 13.8 months (95% CI 12-16) in those assigned to trastuzumab plus chemotherapy compared with 11.1 months (10-13) in those assigned to chemotherapy alone (hazard ratio 0.74; 95% CI 0.60-0.91; p=0.0046).
efficacy.judgement: Matched by juxtaposition: Fujimoto-Ouchi 2007 (doi:10.1007/s00280-006-0337-z) tested the exact capecitabine + cisplatin + trastuzumab triplet in NCI-N87/4-1ST xenografts and ToGA used that regimen. The ToGA paper is paywalled, so whether it cross-references the xenograft work was not verified (comparison_stated false). FDA's 2010 gastric sBLA pharmacology review was not checked (model_filed null).

efficacy.model: HER2-amplified gastric lines and xenografts (NCI-N87, 4-1ST, OE-19)
efficacy.note: Lapatinib (TyTAN 2014, LOGiC 2016), T-DM1 (GATSBY 2017) and pertuzumab (JACOB 2018) were all active in NCI-N87 models and all missed survival in patients.
efficacy.short: Breast HER2 drugs active in model, failed
efficacy.quote: Lapatinib plus paclitaxel demonstrated activity in the second-line treatment of patients with HER2 FISH-positive IHC3+ advanced gastric cancer but did not significantly improve OS in the intent-to-treat population.
efficacy.reason: Model said active; three drugs failed
efficacy.judgement: Year is the first published contradiction (TyTAN, print 2014; NCT00486954 results posted 2013-02-07), not the cleanest one. Model side: lapatinib had its greatest effect in HER2-amplified gastric cells and xenografts and the authors said it 'supports the ongoing clinical investigation' (Wainberg 2010, doi:10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-09-1112); T-DM1 gave complete pathological responses in OE-19 and half of N-87 xenografts (Barok 2011, doi:10.1016/j.canlet.2011.03.002); pertuzumab + trastuzumab regressed NCI-N87/4-1ST (Yamashita-Kashima 2011, doi:10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-10-2927). Patient side: LOGiC OS HR 0.91 (Hecht 2016, doi:10.1200/JCO.2015.62.6598; results posted 2013-10-29), GATSBY OS HR 1.15 (Thuss-Patience 2017, doi:10.1016/S1470-2045(17)30111-0; posted 2016-08-11), JACOB OS HR 0.84 p=0.057 (Tabernero 2018, doi:10.1016/S1470-2045(18)30481-9; posted 2018-02-14). TyTAN did show higher ORR (OR 3.85) and IHC3+ benefit; the contra rests on the primary OS endpoint. Why the model missed: the only primary paper found that puts models and patients together is Sanchez-Vega 2019 (doi:10.1158/2159-8290.CD-18-0598), showing EGFR/MET co-amplification and intratumoral HER2 heterogeneity (89Zr-trastuzumab PET) decide response to HER inhibition in patients and PDX; the clonal, uniformly HER2-high NCI-N87 line has neither property. No paper was found that explicitly states 'the xenograft predicted X and the trial showed Y' for these three drugs. Later matched call overridden by this contra: the same NCI-N87 model regressed with single-dose DS-8201a (Ogitani 2016, doi:10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-15-2822) and DESTINY-Gastric01 confirmed it (Shitara 2020, doi:10.1056/NEJMoa2004413; ORR 51% vs 14%, OS HR 0.59; NCT03329690 results posted 2020-11-27). The model could not separate T-DM1 from T-DXd in HER2-high gastric; it only separated them in HER2-low and T-DM1-insensitive PDX.

safety.note: T-DXd's monkey toxicology was reported as favourable (HNSTD 30 mg/kg); no patient comparison yet published.
safety.quote: Pharmacokinetics and safety profiles of DS-8201a were favorable and the highest non-severely toxic dose was 30 mg/kg in cynomolgus monkeys, supporting DS-8201a as being well tolerated in humans.
safety.judgement: Abstract-level reading (paywalled). The cynomolgus monkey was the toxicology species for the whole class from trastuzumab's 1998 BLA onward, but that use was not verified or cited in this draft, so model_first_use_year is the first verified T-DXd use (2016).

safety.note: Monkeys given T-DXd at 30 mg/kg or more developed interstitial pneumonitis resembling patient ILD; DESTINY-Gastric01 saw ILD in 12 of 125 patients.
safety.quote: The histopathological features of diffuse lymphocytic infiltrates and slight fibrosis were similar to interstitial lung diseases (ILD)/pneumonitis related to anticancer drugs in patients, with an incidence that was dose-dependent and dose-frequency-dependent.
safety.judgement: Open-access source that itself compares monkey histopathology with patient ILD and calls monkeys 'an appropriate model' (source_calls_it match). The 2016 report called monkey safety favourable, yet the same GLP studies (6-week and 3-month, reported in full in 2020) carried the ILD signal at 30 mg/kg or more, roughly 5x the 6.4 mg/kg gastric dose; the match is on histology and dose-dependence, not incidence, hence direction_only. Patient-side anchor in this context: DESTINY-Gastric01 (Shitara 2020, doi:10.1056/NEJMoa2004413; 12 of 125 with adjudicated ILD, NCT03329690 results posted 2020-11-27). No gastric-specific contradiction was found for the antibody: ToGA cardiac events were 6% in both arms. FDA's Enhertu nonclinical review was not checked (model_filed null).
